Porsche has a new sports car in the making, and it could mark the beginning of a very different era for the brand.
The Porsche Mission S is expected to sit above the 911, taking the fight to the likes of Ferrari and Lamborghini. With rumours pointing towards an eight-cylinder engine, possibly a V8 or a flat-eight, this could be one of the most powerful road-going Porsches yet.
